    Google Ads Account Review

    Prepared for Evil Goods · May 25 – Jun 23, 2026

    Account Audit · May 25 – Jun 23, 2026

    Google Ads Account Review

    A 30-day audit of the Evil Goods Google Ads account — account-level conversion health plus a campaign-by-campaign breakdown across both Performance Max campaigns and the Non Branded search campaign.

    ⚠️ Read this first

    Conversion tracking is fully broken across the account. Zero conversions are recording on any campaign, so every performance read below is unreliable until tracking is fixed. Treat that as the gating issue — everything else is secondary.

    01

    Account Level

    Conversion infrastructure and goal configuration.

    Conversion tracking is broken Top priority

    • No conversions recording on any campaign — Cost/conv. shows $0.00 across all campaigns over the last 30 days.
    • Conversion Summary confirms it — the Purchase goal is flagged "Needs attention," all conversion actions show 0.00 conv. / 0.00 value.
    • One action is fully Inactive — "EVIL GOODS! World's BEST Beef Tallow Balm <> AdNabu" shows Inactive with a Troubleshoot prompt.
    • Until this is fixed, no campaign performance can be judged on outcomes — only inputs.

    Conversion Summary — Purchase goal "Needs attention," all actions 0.00, one Inactive.

    Conversion goals aren't isolated to Purchases

    • Every campaign optimizes for multiple goals — "Purchases, Add to cart, Begin checkout, +3 conversion goals" instead of isolating to Purchases only.
    • All campaigns flagged "missing a primary conversion action" — which ties directly back to the broken tracking above.
    • Non Branded also flags "Missing enough relevant keywords."
    • Confirms the $0.00 Cost/conv. across all four campaigns is account-wide, not campaign-specific.

    All four campaigns — multiple goals, missing primary action, $0.00 Cost/conv.

    02

    PMax — "Top Performing Product"

    Single-product PMax, but the listing feed is a mess of duplicate SKUs.

    Listings are duplicate SKUs in foreign currencies

    • Every listing is the same product — Tallow & Manuka Honey Balm (incl. the Spanish "¡MALDAD!" variants), just duplicated across currencies.
    • Foreign currencies despite US-only targeting — £75.00 (GBP), €53.95 (EUR), DOP4,800, PLN236 all present. None should be serving for a US campaign.
    • Top spender is "Not eligible" — the $1,063.70 / 133,973 impr. line item is flagged Not eligible, yet it's absorbing the campaign's spend.
    • Only 1 asset group live, pointing to the whipped beef tallow honey skin cream PDP — so "Top Performing Products" is really a single-product campaign and the name no longer fits.

    "Top Performing Product" — duplicate SKUs across GBP / EUR / DOP / PLN, top line item Not eligible.

    Delivery & signals — mostly fine

    • Headlines — okay.
    • Audience signals — okay.
    • Delivery — roughly 50/50 search and shopping over the last 30 days.
    • Branded leakage — ~22% of last-30-day spend going to branded search terms.
    03

    PMax — "All Products - 1 Exc"

    Functioning as an everyday-ritual-bundle campaign with the entire catalog switched on.

    Listing count doesn't match the catalog Feed issue

    • 1,535 total listings active — but the store only has 5 products (1x with 2 size variants, 1x with 4 scent variants).
    • 1,337 of those are "Not eligible" — only 198 eligible. The feed is massively inflated, almost certainly by currency/region duplication.
    • No audience signals on this campaign.
    • 1 asset group, pointing to the everyday ritual bundle page; search text ads are bundle-focused.
    • Name vs. reality mismatch — it's effectively an "everyday ritual bundle" campaign with all products active in the listing group.

    "All Products" — 1,535 listings (1,337 not eligible) vs. a 5-product store. $200/day budget.

    Delivery & branded

    • Delivery — ~70% text search, ~25% shopping over the last 30 days.
    • Branded leakage — ~11% of last-30-day spend on branded terms.
    04

    Non Branded — Product Keywords

    Running at ~20% of budget with poor visibility, branded leakage, and no negatives.

    Branded terms are leaking into a non-branded campaign

    • 30% of last-30-day spend on branded terms — "evil goods beef tallow" ($145.40), "evil goods whipped tallow honey balm" ($101.23 + $58.19), "evil goods tallow" ($27.09) are all eating non-branded budget.
    • No negative keywords in use at all — Added/Excluded shows "None" on every search term.
    • Currently routing to the ritual bundle.

    Non Branded search terms — branded "evil goods" queries spending, no negatives applied, 0.00 conv. across the board.

    Visibility & Quality Score are poor

    • 72.02% Search Lost IS (rank) over the last 30 days.
    • Impression share under 10%.
    • Top spending keywords flagged "rarely shown (low quality score)" — 2/10 QS (e.g. "beef tallow moisturizer").
    • Context: running at ~20% of budget with very poor performance — but broken conversion tracking is a major confound on any read here.
    →

    Next Steps

    Prioritized actions.

    P1

    Fix conversion tracking. Re-implement the Purchase conversion, resolve the Inactive AdNabu action, and confirm firing on the Conversion Summary page before trusting any data. (Blocker.)

    P1

    Isolate conversion goals to Purchases across all four campaigns once tracking is live.

    P2

    Clean the product feed. Kill foreign-currency duplicate SKUs (GBP/EUR/DOP/PLN) and reconcile the 1,535 listings down to the real 5-product catalog. Resolve the "Not eligible" top spender.

    P2

    Stop branded leakage. Add branded negatives to both PMax campaigns and the Non Branded Search campaign.

    P2

    Add negative keyword lists to Non Branded — currently running with zero negatives.

    P2

    Add audience signals to "All Products." The campaign currently has none — add signals to give the algorithm a starting point for prospecting.

    P3

    Rebuild Non Branded relevancy. Test new headlines mapped to target keywords to lift Quality Score off 2/10 and recover lost impression share.

    P3

    Decide the "Top Performing Product" structure. It's running as a single-product, single-asset-group campaign — confirm whether it should stay single-SKU or expand to a genuine top-performer set, then rename to match.

    P3

    Reconcile campaign naming vs. setup. Both PMax campaigns are misnamed relative to what they actually run (single-product / bundle).
